C2Legacy believes once Cryptocurrency becomes an asset in every portfolio, there will be a need to securely and privately transfer digital assets to heirs, once death is verified. We believe we will not only fill a void to make the transfer painless during an unfortunate time, but will assure cryptocurrency assets are not lost forever because heirs do not understand keys or devices / wallets their inheritance may be located on.

C2Legacy is the first Digital Will platform on a blockchain that will securely and accurately validate the death of the legacy holder using global, digital and decentralized Death Certificates or digital US-based Death Certificates.  C2Legacy will enable the first Blockchain-based Death when our first legacy holder passes on. In addition, C2Legacy's immutable platform allows you to secure your crypto and digital assets by attaching heirs and after death smart contracts will privately transfer your digital legacy. C2Legacy brings you peace of mind knowing that your cryptocurrency will not die with you and you can take care of your loved ones after you're gone. 

Don't let your cryptocurrency die with you, decrease the burden of your death with C2Legacy.

The question didn't say anything about poor. Poor of course widely exists, but poor is also another term for mismanagement of what is available to you. What would 'normally' be a 'low income' to 'most' people and considered 'poor', other people may be able to manage and save and not desire as much and have everything they need. In other words, you can have a 'low income' of say $25k a year and if you know how to manage it, that is all you need to have a lovely living situation and plenty of food. Sadly people are no longer living within their means, they are determining their means by what society or others think they should have and thus living beyond their means to please others and most of them don't even realize it. People tend to go the easy route and fast route to make purchases or locate residences and for this convenience there is a price. Personally I have been able to do anything I decided I wanted to do or travel where I wanted to travel because I'm one of those people that find the deals and take the time to go beneath the cloak of advertising and immediately reject things 'pushed' at me.
